title: Python: E1 follow-up, DEC-303 (a29): opaque MRO fails closed, module-base dotted callee, polymorphic flag pinned
description: DEC-303 (a29) on E1 (GCLI-96, landed in #149): Q1 fixture pinning polymorphicCheck=true on an E1 site and the number of E1 sites flagged reported; Q2 an opaque MRO entry leaves the E1 site unresolved, counted receiver-needs-inference (an unshadowed builtin class is not opaque for this purpose), docstring at resolveConstructedCall stating the rule as built, recall cost reported on the development corpus; Q3 E1's dotted callee restricted to a module base, nested-class negative fixture. Mutation-check each new guard. Also closes GCLI-96 (a29 applied by this task). Re-measure of the five pins afterwards supersedes the 62-entry figure on #149.
implementationNotes: (a29) built on E1 as landed (872966230f65). Q3: resolveConstructedCall resolves a dotted callee only when its root name resolves to a MODULE (resolveBareName kind module with a path, then resolveModuleChain); an Outer.Inner(...) or object-attribute callee is unresolved. Q2: instanceClassOf (new, one place for the E1 construction checks) fails closed on any opaque MRO entry, counted receiver-needs-inference; a base written as a plain name that is an unshadowed builtin (BUILTINS and isUnshadowedBuiltin at the class's own position) is not opaque, so class C(Exception|object|dict) still resolves; typing.X[...] and NamedTuple are opaque. Docstrings state the rules as built. Q1: fixture pins polymorphicCheck=true on an E1 site (C with an overriding subclass D, C().m() is flagged, polymorphicCount 1). Fixtures: Q2 opaque own/absent/inherited (the old 'external base lands external' test is replaced: that site is now receiver-needs-inference), builtin base positives and a shadowed-builtin negative, Q3 nested-class and object-attribute negatives. MUTATION CHECKS (each applied to the check, tests run, source restored): opaque guard removed: 2 red (opaque, builtin/shadowed); builtin exemption always false: 1 red (builtin positives); always true: 2 red; module-root guard removed: 1 red (Q3); polymorphicCheck off: 1 red (Q1). The earlier 62-entry #149 figure is superseded. RE-MEASURE, per site (bin, reason, edge flags, multiset diff), instrumented worktrees, five pins, markerDirsFor: pre = 268d6ef (before E1), mid = 8729662 (E1 as landed), after = this branch. A) pre to mid (E1 without a29): 58 changed (flask 2, jinja 4, httpx 5, rich 47, tqdm 0), 57 receiver to in-repo, 1 to external; 11 in package. B) mid to after (the recall cost of Q2 + Q3, not split between them): 13 sites inRepo to receiver-needs-inference: httpx 2 (both in package: httpx/_auth.py:221:13, httpx/_models.py:404:13, Cookies(...) whose base is typing.MutableMapping[str, str]), rich 11 (2 in package: rich/table.py:721:20, :735:23, Measurement(NamedTuple); 9 tests: test_color, test_segment, test_text; I did not classify each rich site to a reason beyond the Measurement and Color NamedTuple bases), flask 0, jinja 0, tqdm 0. C) pre to after (E1 net with a29): 45 changed (flask 2, jinja 4, httpx 3, rich 36, tqdm 0): 44 receiver to in-repo, 1 receiver to external (flask src/flask/debughelpers.py:98:23, DebugFilesKeyError(...).with_traceback: its base KeyError is an unshadowed builtin, so not opaque); 7 in package source (flask 1, jinja 1, rich 5, httpx 0). E1 sites flagged polymorphic after a29: 1 (jinja tests/test_api.py:391:13, Environment().getattr, subclass override); polymorphicCount 171 to 172 in jinja, unchanged elsewhere; multiplyBoundCount unchanged on all five. NOT MEASURED: precision of the new edges beyond reading examples (held-out spent, python-gate fenced); the effect of a class decorator that replaces the class; the exemption treats any BUILTINS name written as a plain base as a builtin class (a function name used as a base would also pass, which is a runtime error in Python).
finalSummary: DEC-303 (a29) applied to E1: opaque MRO entry fails closed (unshadowed builtin base exempt), dotted callee restricted to a module root, polymorphicCheck pinned by a fixture; five mutation checks red; recall cost of Q2+Q3 on the five pins 13 sites (httpx 2, rich 11), net E1 effect on the pins 45 changed sites.
